parsed.rationale: Although both records carry is_sample_app=false in their context flags, the second member's file path — Shared/Wallpaper/Examples/WallpaperSampleApp/Sources/DebugHUD.swift — places it unambiguously under the Examples/WallpaperSampleApp/ directory tree, which is a restraint-marker path per the decision rules. The duplicate of DebugMetricsProvider.measureMemoryUsage in DebugHUD.swift is therefore a deliberate local copy for the sample app's debug HUD, not an accidental divergence. Lifting it into the production DebugPanel package would couple the sample app's demonstration semantics into shared production code, which is the canonical anti-pattern the restraint rule guards against.
